title: A MESSAGE FROM #PETER THE #APOSTLE
segments: I witnessed incredible Miracles and
teachings from the Son of God himself
after jesus' resurrection and Ascension
into heaven I continued to proclaim the
good news with unring faith and passion
he preached healed and baptized
countless individuals spreading the
message of Hope and salvation to all who
would listen as the years passed a storm
began to brew in Rome threatening the
early Israelite Community emperor Nero
had become increasingly hostile towards
Israelites blaming them for the city's
misfortunes and his Relentless Pursuit
narrow embarked on a cruel campaign of
persecution against the followers of
Christ news reached my wife and I and we
felt a heaviness in our hearts we now
know that the time has come for us to
carry the cross of martyrdom of our
faith so I'm here now in Rome accepting
the consequences of spreading the gospel
I won't be deterred by fear instead we
find comfort in the knowledge that our
suffering would bring glory to God and
strengthen the faith of his fellow
Believers our martydom will stir the
hearts of countless Believers and lead
to the steadfastness in faith that could
not be
extinguished
